title: Lattice-chain approximation of finite-mass integer multiplicity currents in ℝ^{n+ℓ} (Simon 6.2, first paragraph)
lean_statement: DeformationTheorem → ∀ m ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ ℓ → ∀ X : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ))) (m + 1), (∀ k, IsIntegerMultiplicity (X k)) → (∀ k, (X k).mass + (X k).boundary.mass < ∞) → ∃ (ρ : ℕ → ℝ) (β : ℕ → LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) (m + 1 + ℓ) → ℤ) (Pc : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ))) (m + 1)), (∀ k, 0 < ρ k) ∧ Antitone ρ ∧ Tendsto ρ atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ (∀ k, IsLatticeChain (ρ k) (fun F => (β k F : ℝ)) (Pc k)) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ))) (m + 1), Tendsto (fun k => Pc k ω - X k ω) atTop (𝓝 0)
